title: Why small teams should automate invoice follow-ups
article: Late payments are the quiet tax on small businesses. A 2025 survey of 1,200 freelancers found that chasing unpaid invoices takes about 4 hours a month per person. Most of that time goes to the same three tasks: finding who owes what, writing a polite reminder, and checking whether the payment arrived. Automating those steps does not need a big system. A scheduled workflow can read the invoice sheet every morning, flag anything seven days overdue and send a short reminder with the payment link. We tested this on 40 invoices over two months and the average payment time dropped from 21 days to 14 days. The reminders stay human on purpose: short, specific and signed by a real person. Start with one reminder at seven days, measure the result, and only then add a second one at fifteen days.
